purpose: Cesium target-vessel display assets for colav-simulator

policy.license_filter: CC0 preferred; user-collected models marked unverified are display-only
policy.physical_scale: Scale visual model to authoritative target dimensions at runtime; source geometry is display-only.
policy.warning: Do not infer vessel type, dynamics, collision domain, draft, or hydrodynamics from the mesh.

history: Kenney Watercraft Kit entries removed 2026-10-20 (user deleted the cartoon low-poly set in favour of higher-detail maritime models); pre-removal manifest in git history.

assets.notes: Bulk carrier visual; textures embedded. Default target visual for OT/HO/CS and multi-ship scenarios (2026-10-20 user decision: larger target for DT-viewport YOLO verification). Bow at glTF -Z (side-profile marker render evidence).
High-detail harbor tug visual; textures embedded. Bow at glTF -Z (side-profile marker render evidence; end-width taper ambiguous on fendered tug hulls).
Cruise ferry visual (Viking-Line style livery); textures embedded. Normalized 2026-10-20: rotated to Z-long with bow at +Z, scaled native units to metres.
5.1 m cabin fishing boat, textures embedded, metres +Y up.
7.34 m RIB, textures embedded, metres +Y up.
